current: Brazilian CONTRAN Resolution 949/2022 (28 March 2022) sets occupant protection requirements for side impact against a deformable barrier and against a pole, for domestic and imported automobiles, light trucks, vans and utility vehicles. Results of tests under UN technical regulations or North American standards are accepted as an alternative. Entry into force 1 April 2022, with phased application dates for the barrier requirements (2020, 2024) and pole requirements (2026, 2030).
proposed: CONTRAN 949/2022 sets side-barrier and pole-impact protection for specified cars, vans, pickups and utility vehicles. Barrier scope depends on seat R-point height; pole scope has mass or pickup-geometry conditions and listed exemptions. Barrier requirements phase in in 2020/2024 and pole requirements in 2026/2030. Applicable UN or North American test results are alternatives; pole tests expressly accept UN R135 or FMVSS 214.
evidence: Art2§1 limits barrier requirements to vehicles with at least one seat R-point not exceeding700mm above ground at reference mass. Art3§1 limits car/van/utility pole scope to PBT<=3500kg and pickups to specified angle or dimensional ratio. Art4 lists excluded off-road, special, military, transformed, small-series, artisan, replica and buggy vehicles. Art3§2 expressly accepts UN-R135 or FMVSS214 pole results. Current scope summary presents the vehicle classes without these scope gates.

current: CONTRAN Resolution 954/2022 requires Electronic Stability Control (ESC) on new M1 and N1 vehicles, with a Vehicle Stability Function (VSF) allowed as an alternative only for N1 and for M1 above 1,735 kg. VSF is mandatory for M2, M3, N2 and N3, and roll-stability VSF is required for O3 and O4 trailers; it is optional for exclusively urban M3 but mandatory for school vehicles.
proposed: Requires ESC for new M1/N1 vehicles, allowing VSF for N1 and M1 above 1,735 kg running-order mass. Directional and roll VSF applies to M2/M3/N2 and specified N3 configurations; roll VSF applies to O3/O4 with one to three axles. Exclusively urban M3 fitment is optional except school vehicles. Vehicle exemptions and phased dates apply; applicable UN R13-H/R13/R140 or FMVSS 126 test results demonstrate performance.
evidence: Art3§2: M1 alternative threshold is "massa em ordem de marcha superior a 1.735 kg" (running-order mass). Art3§3 specifies N3 with two/three axles, or four axles at maximum technical mass<=25t and wheel diameter<=19.5in. Art3§4 specifies O3/O4 with one, two or three axles. Art6 provides vehicle exemptions. Art4 accepts ECE R13-H/R13/R140 or FMVSS126 results "conforme aplicável". Current summary says all N3 and all O3/O4 require VSF without the configuration limits.

current: Brazilian CONTRAN Resolution 970/2022 (20 June 2022) sets the technical characteristics and specifications of vehicle lighting and signalling systems and devices, and governs the use of special lamps on vehicles. It applies to automobiles, light trucks, trucks, truck tractors, buses, minibuses, trailers and semi-trailers, and accepts UN/UNECE or FMVSS test results as an alternative. Entry into force 1 July 2022.
proposed: CONTRAN 970/2022 sets technical specifications for vehicle lighting and signalling, including special lamps. It covers cars, trucks, buses, trailers and semi-trailers, plus motorcycles, mopeds, tricycles and quadricycles under separate annexes. UN/UNECE or FMVSS test results may demonstrate applicable performance requirements. Entered into force 1 July 2022.
evidence: Art3 lists automobiles through trailers/semi-trailers. Art4 separately covers "motocicletas, motonetas, ciclomotores, triciclos e quadriciclos" and their applicable annexes. Art14 accepts UN/UNECE or FMVSS performance-test results. Art21: force from1July2022. Current vehicle-scope summary omits the entire Article4 group despite its presence in the metadata Motorcycle tag.

current: Decree 12.435 of 15 April 2025, published in the Official Gazette on 16 April 2025, regulates Brazil's Green Mobility and Innovation Program (MOVER), the successor to Rota 2030. It sets technical and environmental parameters for energy efficiency, recyclability and security that vehicle makers and importers must meet to commercialize vehicles in Brazil from June 2025.
proposed: Government news article about Decree 12.435/2025 regulating the MOVER program. It reports technical and environmental parameters for vehicle makers and importers, including energy efficiency and recyclability, with commercialization requirements from June 2025. This record holds the announcement, rather than the decree text; consult the linked Official Gazette decree for legal requirements.
evidence: Body headline: "President Lula signs decree that regulates Green Mobility and Innovation Program"; page category "Latest News", publishedApr17,2025. Main paragraph: decree signedApr15, "Published in this Wednesday's (16) Official Gazette", establishes "technical and environmental parameters ... vehicle makers and importers must follow ... as of June2025" and links to Official Gazette Decree12.435. There are no decree articles in the body. Existing summary also calls MOVER "successor to Rota2030", which this own body does not state.
